subject: control aspect (ratio) of a graph: asp=1

messages.author: e53f91d0708becab
messages.subject: control aspect (ratio) of a graph: asp=1
parts:
Is there a way to control aspect ratio of ggplot in the same way we do
with plot(x=x,y=y,asp=1)?
As discussed elsewhere, This is critical for any geografical
(projected) dataset.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: control aspect (ratio) of a graph: asp=1
parts:
For maps, use + coord_map(). If the data is already projected use +
coord_equal()

Hadley
